proved_translations.statement: For smooth complex Weil representations, Frobenius semisimplicity is equivalent to semisimplicity of every Weil operator.
proved_translations.proof: Finite inertia image; a centralizing Frobenius power; semisimple positive powers of invertible complex operators imply semisimplicity.

proved_translations.statement: If rho is irreducible of dimension m+1 and tau is semisimple of dimension m, then (rho tensor tau)^I=0.
proved_translations.proof: An inertia overlap between irreducible Weil representations forces them to differ by an unramified twist and hence have equal dimensions.

critical_normalization: The source induction relation ignores monodromy. Its IsDeligneEps witness is the underlying-Weil epsilon constant at s=1/2, with self-dual additive measure. Adjacent-rank cuspidal pairs have no inertia invariants, so neither their L-factors nor the WD monodromy correction changes the corresponding functional equation.
